title: VAST G1-J8 preset bank file
description: MANY sounds for the VAST G1-J8 (websynth) synthesizer in one file, keyed by preset name — the vintage naming: a preset is one sound, a bank is a collection. Each entry has the same shape as a websynth-preset file's `params`. Use a bank when asked for a set or kit of patches. Parameter ids, ranges and defaults are generated live by the app (Song panel → "AI Prompt") and by the repo's MCP server tool `get_preset_format`.

name.description: Bank name — used for the exported filename, not for any stored preset.

presets.description: Preset name -> parameter map. Must hold at least one entry; a name that already exists on the device is resolved by the import wizard (keep both / overwrite / skip).
